application_id.description: The ID of the application the workspace is associated with.

auto_group.description:
When `true`, specifies that newly created grants in the application are automatically assigned
to the workspace if their email address' domain matches the `domain`.

created_at.description: When the workspace was created, in seconds using the Unix timestamp format.

default.description:
When `true`, the workspace is the application's default workspace, which Nylas creates and
manages. Nylas includes this field when you retrieve workspaces. For more information, see
the [Workspaces overview](/docs/reference/api/workspaces/).

domain.description: The top-level domain associated with the workspace.

policy_id.description:
The ID of the [policy](/docs/v3/agent-accounts/policies-rules-lists/) attached to the workspace.
The policy applies to Agent Accounts in the workspace.

rule_ids.description:
The IDs of any [rules](/docs/v3/agent-accounts/policies-rules-lists/#rules) attached to the
workspace. The rules apply to Agent Accounts in the workspace.

updated_at.description:
When the workspace was last updated, in seconds using the Unix timestamp format. Initially, this
value is the same as `created_at`.
